peer.application: original egg 0.9.5 with the acquired rules
peer.build: upstream documented dynamic Z3 configuration; version and lock retained

semantics: exact rational polynomial projection of original FPCore bodies; no IEEE-754 equivalence or range-dependent simplification
grammar: exact decimal and integer constants representable by both worker bridges
unsupported: retain every original program; variable denominators, non-polynomial operators, control flow and excessive inputs are unsupported

limits.memory: 512 MiB JVM heap; external RSS observed separately, no equal-RSS claim

warmup: none; report first request and later requests separately
outcome: exact coefficient comparison of every returned candidate; source-only requests, all failed and unsupported rows retained
cost: surface arithmetic operations, one per binary operation or unary negation; startup, acquisition, request including bridge and judge reported separately; internal work units never equated
claimBoundary: public development pilot; not an unseen holdout, independent human evaluation, novelty or general performance claim
